comment:
* Represents a group of ads, with information about their states. * *

Instances are immutable. Call the {@code with*} methods to get new instances that have the * required changes.

variables.name: timeUs
variables.comment:
* The time of the ad group in the {@link Timeline.Period}, in microseconds, or {@link
     * C#TIME_END_OF_SOURCE} to indicate a postroll ad.

variables.name: count
variables.comment: The number of ads in the ad group, or {@link C#LENGTH_UNSET} if unknown.

variables.name: uris
variables.comment: The URI of each ad in the ad group.

variables.name: states
variables.comment: The state of each ad in the ad group.

variables.name: durationsUs
variables.comment: The durations of each ad in the ad group, in microseconds.

variables.name: contentResumeOffsetUs
variables.comment:
* The offset in microseconds which should be added to the content stream when resuming playback
     * after the ad group.

variables.name: isServerSideInserted
variables.comment: Whether this ad group is server-side inserted and part of the content stream.

variables.name: CREATOR
variables.comment: Object that can restore {@link AdGroup} from a {@link Bundle}.

methods.name: public int getFirstAdIndexToPlay()
methods.comment:
* Returns the index of the first ad in the ad group that should be played, or {@link #count} if
     * no ads should be played.

methods.name: public int getNextAdIndexToPlay(@IntRange(from = -1) int lastPlayedAdIndex)
methods.comment:
* Returns the index of the next ad in the ad group that should be played after playing {@code
     * lastPlayedAdIndex}, or {@link #count} if no later ads should be played. If no ads have been
     * played, pass -1 to get the index of the first ad to play.

methods.name: public boolean shouldPlayAdGroup()
methods.comment: Returns whether the ad group has at least one ad that should be played.

methods.name: public boolean hasUnplayedAds()
methods.comment: * Returns whether the ad group has at least one ad that is neither played, skipped, nor failed.

methods.name: public AdGroup withTimeUs(long timeUs)
methods.comment: Returns a new instance with the {@link #timeUs} set to the specified value.

methods.name: public AdGroup withAdCount(int count)
methods.comment: Returns a new instance with the ad count set to {@code count}.

methods.name: public AdGroup withAdUri(Uri uri, @IntRange(from = 0) int index)
methods.comment:
* Returns a new instance with the specified {@code uri} set for the specified ad, and the ad
     * marked as {@link #AD_STATE_AVAILABLE}.

methods.name: public AdGroup withAdState(@AdState int state, @IntRange(from = 0) int index)
methods.comment:
* Returns a new instance with the specified ad set to the specified {@code state}. The ad * specified must currently either be in {@link #AD_STATE_UNAVAILABLE} or {@link * #AD_STATE_AVAILABLE}. * *

This instance's ad count may be unknown, in which case {@code index} must be less than the * ad count specified later. Otherwise, {@code index} must be less than the current ad count.

methods.name: public AdGroup withAdDurationsUs(long[] durationsUs)
methods.comment: Returns a new instance with the specified ad durations, in microseconds.

methods.name: public AdGroup withContentResumeOffsetUs(long contentResumeOffsetUs)
methods.comment: Returns an instance with the specified {@link #contentResumeOffsetUs}.

methods.name: public AdGroup withIsServerSideInserted(boolean isServerSideInserted)
methods.comment: Returns an instance with the specified value for {@link #isServerSideInserted}.

methods.name: public AdGroup withAllAdsSkipped()
methods.comment:
* Returns an instance with all unavailable and available ads marked as skipped. If the ad count
     * hasn't been set, it will be set to zero.

methods.name: public AdGroup withAllAdsReset()
methods.comment:
* Returns an instance with all ads in final states (played, skipped, error) reset to either
     * available or unavailable, which allows to play them again.

private static long[] copyDurationsUsWithSpaceForAdCount(long[] durationsUs, int count)
private static String keyForField(@AdGroup.FieldNumber int field)
